newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Vietnamese PM arrives in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Vietnamese PM arrives in Hungary.

text.p: Vietnam's prime minister Vo Van Kiet began a two-day official visit to Hungary on Tuesday which is expected to focus on trade.

Kiet, accompanied by five ministers and a 15-strong business delegation, will visit an industrial exhibition, a canned food manufacturer and will hold talks with Prime Minister Gyula Horn and Industry and Trade Minister Szabolcs Fazakas.
The visit forms part of a foreign relations offensive by Kiet, 74, who arrived in Hungary at the end of a tour which has taken in Poland, the Czech republic and Italy.
